long_description:
As the leaves change and nature prepares to turn inward, take a moment to ground yourself. Join World Peace Yoga for an autumn dose of rejuvenation, peace, healing, and bliss. Treat yourself and perhaps a friend or family member to this special seasonal yoga practice designed to help you slow down, center, and let go of what no longer serves you. All are welcome. No yoga experience necessary. Come as you are and enjoy a tranquil mini retreat in your day.

Includes:

🍁 Autumn Grounding Restorative Yoga Practice: Integrating deeply comforting relaxation massage techniques to release physical tension.

☮️Guided Deep Rest: Immerse yourself in a warm and cozy experience to soothe the mind.

🍵Seasonal Plant-Based Bites: Enjoy nourishing autumn flavors paired with comforting tea.

❤️Community Connection: Learn about our signature massage and reiki offerings. Plus receive an exclusive discount offer when you attend the event.

Sunday, October 25

2:00-3:45 pm

Investment: $27
